suggestions.original_text: Backend engineer with 5 years of experience building distributed systems. Comfortable across the stack with a focus on Python, payments infrastructure, and developer tooling.
suggestions.suggested_text: Senior backend engineer with 5+ years of Python experience building high-throughput distributed systems. Track record of operating revenue-critical payment services on-call, partnering with risk and finance teams, and driving incremental migrations from legacy monoliths to focused services.
suggestions.rationale: Aligns the summary with the JD's explicit emphasis on Python, payments, on-call, and monolith decomposition while still being accurate to the existing experience.

suggestions.original_text: - Worked on the payments team building backend services.
suggestions.suggested_text: - Designed and shipped Python services on the payments team, including invoice-retry logic that recovered ~$2.4M/yr in transient declines.
suggestions.rationale: JD specifically asks for Python + billing/invoicing reliability. Quantifying the impact lifts the bullet to staff-level signal.

suggestions.original_text: - Improved the speed of a slow batch job.
suggestions.suggested_text: - Cut p95 latency on the nightly billing batch from 88m to 14m by parallelizing PostgreSQL reads and rewriting the hot loop in Go.
suggestions.rationale: Concrete numbers, mentions PostgreSQL (JD), and ties to billing — a much stronger 'dive deep' signal at staff level.

suggestions.suggested_text: - Carried primary on-call for the billing service; reduced page volume 38% by replacing raw error-rate alerts with SLO-based alerting in Datadog.
suggestions.rationale: JD requires on-call experience and lists Datadog. Inserting a bullet that captures both, anchored to a real responsibility area.

suggestions.original_text: - Built REST endpoints in Python for the public API.
suggestions.suggested_text: - Built and operated the rate-limited public API in Python (used by 200+ partner integrations), including JWT auth, request shaping, and Kafka-backed audit logging.
suggestions.rationale: Adds Kafka (in the JD tech stack) and quantifies reach. Still grounded in the original bullet's responsibility.

suggestions.original_text: - Helped migrate a legacy monolith to a service-oriented architecture.
suggestions.suggested_text: - Led the cut-over of the user-billing module out of a legacy Django monolith into a focused Python service, with a feature-flagged dual-write phase to de-risk the migration.
suggestions.rationale: JD calls out 'incremental migrations from the legacy monolith.' Re-phrasing the bullet to mirror that exact concern and showing the de-risking pattern reads as senior.

suggestions.original_text: - Contributed bug fixes to the company's open-source SDK.
suggestions.rationale: Internship bullet that doesn't move the needle for a Senior Staff JD. Trimming keeps the resume tight.

suggestions.original_text: Python, Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda), Terraform, Docker, Linux, Git.
suggestions.suggested_text: Python, Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, SQS), Terraform, Docker, Datadog, Linux, Git.
suggestions.rationale: Adds Datadog and SQS — both surface area the JD explicitly calls out (Datadog is in the tech stack; SQS pairs naturally with the event-driven note).

suggestions.original_text: A small key-value store I wrote in Go for fun. Implements a write-ahead log, basic compaction, and an HTTP API.
suggestions.suggested_text: A small key-value store I wrote in Go to learn storage internals. Implements a write-ahead log with crash recovery, size-tiered compaction, and an HTTP API. Useful here as an example of dive-deep work into the durability and recovery patterns relevant to a payments backend.
suggestions.rationale: Adds the words 'durability' and 'recovery' which map to the JD's reliability emphasis, without inventing any new project scope.
